notes.title: COLD DEPTH v0.5.4 is here. Check it out
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Used Gel melter not snap to gel anymore. This is misleading (thanks magiKEY)
[*][b]Improved[/b]: Pockets logic. Now in the start, you have 3 pocket slots and new suits add extra pockets. After loading from an old save file, items from unavailable pockets are dropped behind you.

notes.content:

I am happy to present the COLD DEPTH [b]update v0.4[/b] codename "[b]Monsters[/b]"

This update [b]adds unique monsters[/b] to some stations, changing health and cold systems, visual effects, and more. 

What's new:
[list]
[*] New monsters
[*] Whale. Friend or not?
[*] New visual effects for Quantum Packer
